facts.fact: Chathu's left foot is uneven from an old break.
Vellan told Neela earlier 'Eleven for eleven. You've never missed.'
Devan told Neela about Muthu's quiet tell when he lies.
Neela learned to open the shed lock at fourteen, on a dare.
Neela and Ammu used the drain path through the Resin House wall as children.
Neela ordered Muthu to follow by cart at the second dusk, meeting her on the wood road; the cart is due at the Resin House gate at tonight's dusk, where Vellan will wait.
Neela now resolves to say the word herself, aloud, to someone before she is caged, without yet knowing the self-naming loophole.
